gloss: to become dull; to weaken; to slow down

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {鈍|にぶ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to become dull; to lose sharpness
definitions.explanation: For a blade or edge to lose its sharpness through use or neglect.

definitions.gloss: to weaken; to slow down; to deteriorate
definitions.explanation: For skills, senses, speed, or determination to decline or lose their edge. A figurative extension of the literal meaning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{切|き}れ{味|あじ}→切れ味：19110_kireaji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鈍|にぶ}った。
examples.english: The kitchen knife has gone dull.

examples.japanese: ⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ハサミ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鈍|にぶ}る。
examples.english: Scissors get dull if you keep using them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦{研|と}いでいない→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧だいぶ{鈍|にぶ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Since I haven't sharpened it in a long time, the blade has become quite dull.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧サボる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鈍|にぶ}る。
examples.english: If you skip practice, your skills deteriorate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感覚|かんかく}→感覚：02593_kankaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鈍|にぶ}って、⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{押|お}せなかった→押す：02854_osu⟧。
examples.english: My hands were so numb from the cold that I couldn't press the buttons properly.

notes:
{鈍|にぶ}る is an intransitive godan verb. The transitive form is {鈍|にぶ}らせる (to make dull, to cause to weaken).

ASPECT (ている):
{鈍|にぶ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the resulting state of being dull or weakened.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鈍|にぶ}る (a blade becomes dull)
- ⟦{勘|かん}→勘：02149_kan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鈍|にぶ}る (intuition weakens)
- ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鈍|にぶ}る (skills deteriorate)
- ⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鈍|にぶ}る (movements slow down)
- ⟦{感覚|かんかく}→感覚：02593_kankaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鈍|にぶ}る (sensation becomes numb)

RELATED WORDS:
The adjective ⟦{鈍|にぶ}い→鈍い：00315_nibui⟧ (dull, slow) shares the same kanji. Compare with ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧ (sharp) and ⟦{鋭|するど}く→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become sharp), which express the opposite direction.
